sourceNotes: OSM coverage-gap import (2026-06): created from OpenStreetMap beach "Παραλία Μονατήρι" (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/5768708365) in Antiparos, South Aegean. Coordinates from OSM. Verified as a real, distinct Greek swimmable beach by adversarial web check (>2541m from any existing beach). Google confirms a beach (93 ratings) 58m from the pin. Slot via nearest existing beach #1733 (2541m). Access/terrain unknown — needs field verification.
Paros/Naxos audit 2026-08-13: spelling: «Μονατήρι» → «Μοναστήρι». The old slug paralia-monatiri is kept in legacySlugs so the existing URL still resolves.

Water depth from EMODnet bathymetry 2026-08-25: 6.07 m at 100 m offshore on the W bearing (beach faces 254.4°), profile confidence high. Above the national p75 of 5.9 m, so the water is demonstrably not shallow; recorded as "medium". Bathymetry can prove the steep side only, never the shallow one — no "shallow" is ever written from it. Previously the field was absent and the app inferred depth from shore surface. No other field changed.
